title: Costs
no_org: Open an organization to see its costs.
about_costs: What {org}'s model calls and IDE sessions cost. Usage is recorded as tokens and pod time; the money comes from the price list, so a changed price reprices the past too.
about_budgets: Budgets say what the organization, a workspace or a project may spend in a calendar month. They warn; they never stop anyone.
about_view_only: Only the organization's administrators, or people granted cost.view, see the costs.
not_counted: This Studio does not count costs yet (the backend predates them).
no_prices_title: No prices set: usage is counted, cost shows $0
personal_hint: What people spent on keys in their own profiles or personal connections
nothing_used: Nothing was used in this period.
row_unpriced: Part of this row has no price
report_unpriced: * No price for {models}: counted above, not in the cost.
prices_hint: Per model, the price of a million tokens of each kind; for IDE sessions, an hour of a requested CPU core and GiB of memory. A model ending in * prices every model that starts with the rest.
no_model_priced: No model is priced: model calls are counted but cost nothing in the report.
session_cpu: IDE session, per CPU core hour
prices_saved: Prices saved. The report is priced with them, past usage included.
prices_manage_only: Only the organization's administrators, or people granted cost.manage, change prices.
budgets_not_counted: This Studio has no budgets yet (the backend predates them).
budgets_hint: What the organization, a workspace or a project may spend in a calendar month (UTC), in {currency}. A budget warns at {percent}% and when this month's pace would pass it; it never stops anyone.
budgets_no_personal: People's own keys are left out, as in the report.
forecast_later: Projected from the fourth day of the month
budgets_unpriced: No price for {models}: not in the spend above, so a budget may be nearer than it shows.
budgets_manage_only: Only the organization's administrators, or people granted cost.manage, change budgets.
